title: KENWORTH TSeries T909 T908 T950 Custom Built Powder Coated FUPS compliant 4 post Road Train Bullbar #101
description: Kenworth T909, T908 high tensile POWDER COATED aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar 381 high tensile channel. 88mm diameter pipe with 6mm wall but optional 76mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. All pipes are one piece, no but welds to uprights. Extra Heavy Reinforced 4 post design ensures maximum protection to the bonnet and radiator. 100mm full length reinforced box uprights shown. Cow catcher and 3 small uprights. Reversible aluminium road train signs with KW logo on reverse side plus fold down OVERSIZE signs. Provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty steel backing plate with 38mm tow pin plus tow plate surround. Spring assist to help raise and lower the bar. Large Range of Powder Coat colours available. Provision for light bar & driving lights. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements including polishing in lieu of powder coating.
